candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its downstream order call times out (ReadTimeout, transport error) at ~2s; order in turn times out calling payment. Payment authorizations eventually succeed (~3s), indicating payment latency exceeds the gateway/order client timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side service metrics/traces; payment latency inferred from late 200 authorizations. Exact timeout config unknown.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s (~2s) trace to order client ReadTimeout; order's payment call also ReadTimeouts while payment authorizations return 200 only after ~3s. Consistent with downstream latency exceeding client timeouts, but payment-side telemetry is absent, so confidence is moderate.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and spans to confirm payment is the slow dependency
Order service logs/traces showing its payment client timeout configuration
Gateway and order client timeout settings to confirm the ~2s threshold
